builds.name: Warpgate Nowi
builds.desc:
Grimoire - Grimoire lets her warp to a space adjacent to any ally with 2 squares while shes sitting above 50% HP.
Reposition and Moonbow -
Reposition and Moonbow are generic staples. These can be swapped for anything to fit your needs.
Atk/Res Bond -
Due to the nature of Grimoire and Escape Route, sticking with Atk/Res Bond in the a slot makes sense.
Escape Route -
Escape Route compliments Grimoire's effect nicely, and lets her warp to a space adjacent to any ally should she fall below that 50% threshold.
Drive Atk -
Since this build is best utilized outside of Flier Emblem, a generic Spur or Drive buff is ideal.
Guidance -
With Grimoire and Escape Route bolstering her own mobility, in addition to being a flier, equipping the Guidance Sacred Seal turns her into a powerful mobility tool for any Armor or Infantry team.

builds.name: Owl Tome Flying Emblem
builds.desc:
Focuses on buffing stats during combat for doubles. Use with Flying Emblem team.
Rauðrowl+ allows for Atk/Spd/Def/Res boost. +2/+4/+6 depending on allies Nowi is next to. The Spd refine allows for +2 Spd for increased double attack opportunities.
Luna or Moonbow work well for damage.
Slot A can use Atk/Res Bond 3 just fine for +5 Atk/Res next to ally - you want to boost attack as much as you can, Atk/Spd Bond 3 works best to increase Spd to ensure double attacks but costly to inherit.
Slot B is flexible for use. Axebreaker 3 works well vs Hector in arena. Desperation 3 also works well for allowing quick quad attack kills when weakened. Use as needed for what you have - cater to your combat needs.
Slot A can be Hone Fliers for Emblem synergy but use this for buffs / debuffs as needed.
Sacred Seal Flier Formation 3 works well for Nowi to move around her allies. Allows for best positioning for Rauðrowl+ moving freely to adjacent spots.
This build allows Nowi to feel similar to her Grimoire to allow wider range of movement for stat boosting and allowing her to nuke foes from afar. Flier Formation has synergy with weapon allowing to move next to flying emblem allies with ease for easy buffing of combat stats.
Use with an all flying emblem team.
